definitions.supplemental: Cf. Icel. ofr-menni a mighty champion.
definitions.meaning: A man superior to others, an illustrious person

quotations.english: the angel sent to save Guthlac

source_text: ofer-mæcga, an; m. A man superior to others, an illustrious person :-- Ofermæcga spræc dýre Dryhtnes þegn (the angel sent to save Guthlac), Exon. Th. 143, 21; Gu. 664. [Cf. Icel. ofr-menni a mighty champion.]
